check.population: every interface, class hierarchy and dependency edge in the object model
check.freshness: a verdict stands until an interface, an override or a dependency changes
check.refusal: the dependency rule or the contract test fails a change that breaks substitution, segregation or dependency direction
check.observation: interface usage, override contracts and dependency direction, read from source and contract tests
check.evidence: none: the catalog states this check as a class, so a watched run belongs to each system that adopts it
check.authority: the interface contract, which every implementation and override conforms to

records.name: Interface Segregation Principle (ISP)
records.definition: A design rule that a client depends on an interface holding only the methods it uses.

distinctFrom.reason: Dependency inversion fixes which side owns the abstraction, while inversion of control moves object creation and control flow to a framework or composition root.

records.name: Dependency Inversion Principle (DIP)
records.definition: A design rule that high-level policy and low-level detail both depend on an abstraction owned by the policy.

distinctFrom.reason: The open/closed principle adds behavior without editing existing code, while composability combines parts through compatible interfaces.

records.name: Open/Closed Principle (OCP)
records.definition: A design rule that a module gains new behavior by adding code at an extension point, leaving its existing code unchanged.

records.name: Liskov Substitution Principle (LSP)
records.definition: A design rule that a subtype can replace its base type anywhere, because it keeps the base type's preconditions, postconditions and invariants.
measured_by: contract test pass rate across subtypes

distinctFrom.reason: Polymorphism is one interface with several implementations, while dynamic dispatch is the runtime selection of which one runs, from the receiver or a keyed table.
Polymorphism varies the implementation behind a type, while type safety rejects operations on the wrong type.

records.name: Polymorphism
records.definition: A mechanism that lets one interface have several implementations, with the implementation chosen by the object that receives the call.
